notes.title: Boat Rowing + New Campus environment
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41392577/c156ace43d8c397211cf1a8490a34f5c39552e90.png[/img]If you've been following our updates, you know we've had a Boat Rowing Meditation mode in development for some time!

Inspired by walking meditations and designed from the ground up for XR, our spatial computing-based moving meditation is an opportunity for you to experience present-focused use of your body like never before!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41392577/49ff9d42bab6b41477be9532a0d00ef6a5d945d2.gif[/img]

Boat Rowing Mode is available now! Simply go to the Main Menu and select "Boat Rowing" and begin with the tutorial. We also invite you to EXPLORE the completely overhauled environments! This update includes a brand new refresh of the valley that has expanded in pursuit of our long-term vision of a meditation campus, and eventual live multiplayer classes (coming TBD this year).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41392577/dd14db3bf5e730abb1e724bf6f730985fde47a73.gif[/img]

Your new campus grounds are designed as the perfect setting for all of the current and future content updates in the works for 2024 and beyond... you'll notice hints at future features hidden throughout the island! Let us know what you're most excited for!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41392577/d64dfc3180cc14452f1fd8156f8985eb56596df6.png[/img]

It's been found that community can enhance one's practice by promoting focus and motivation. 🧘‍♀️🧘🏾🧘‍♂️🧘🏿🧘🏼‍♂️.

Stay up-to-date and connect with fellow meditators by joining the ZenVR community: http://www.zenvrapp.com/connect on Facebook, Discord, and r/ZenVR. We'll be hosting active discussions with fellow meditators and you’ll also receive regular zen content designed to supplement the lessons and concepts core to meditation as well as encourage you to maintain a regular habit of practicing.

Happy meditating,
Matt Golino - Founder of ZenVR®

notes.title: UPDATE - Quick Sessions mode + NEW Kai Avatar + NEW Onboarding Experience
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41392577/f262a30c6f1f9b860c0210b69bece635ecd77d36.png[/img]

A Brand new mode - Quick Sessions - is here, offering a set of 12 curated sessions, each 5 - 20 min long, that provide a shorter alternative to full, 30-minute long lessons. These sessions are available from the main menu and provide 3 progression levels that include 4 sessions each. 

Looking for a refresher or just want to jump into some of the most popular immersive experiences like the Compassion Contemplation meditation? Simply navigate to Quick Sessions from the main menu to begin!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41392577/406bd113aaef850f22694cce832be0a9cb8287b7.png[/img]

This major update also includes an overhaul to the Kai avatar as well as a brand new Onboarding experience (15 minutes long) that is designed to provide users of all VR and meditation skill levels an introduction and overview of the ZenVR learning system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41392577/f49b798fdf04ca5b3376ca488c2add4f2226b8d0.png[/img]

This FREE update also includes several refinements, most noticeably the following:

[*] New Main Menu
[*] Screen Fade Transitions
[*] Unlockable Plants Per Lesson
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE - Animals and Virtual Classmates
notes.content:
The ZenVR™ valley comes to life in this week's update. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41392577/b8a58e9234595a988aebc1d49727f03bd824b229.png[/img]

Several species of birds, mammals, and more have migrated here and will now greet you as you peruse the menus or explore the grounds. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41392577/94064cd81d52b77e1ef5d2b86451e37b4e4ac500.png[/img]

We're excited to share that several new classmates will now accompany you in your meditation sessions. Built using the Ready Player Me avatar system, these virtual peers are simply here to add to your experience in your learning space, as it’s often found that meditating in a group enhances one’s practice by promoting focus and motivation. In addition, it also provides the opportunity to learn by hearing about other people’s experiences and how they overcome challenges in their practice. Several lessons include a Q&A section at the end where you will be able to hear commonly asked questions and answers related to both the specific lesson at hand and the meditation journey you have all embarked on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41392577/7297727db814fc963eb566a69d73be1fda326199.png[/img]

We're also excited to offer an unlockable Moth Orchid that will display next to the main menus. As you progress through Learn and Practice mode, you will eventually be prompted to complete an optional, quick survey. Simply follow the instructions to start the process and the Moth Orchid will automatically unlock in-game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41392577/119732998bbf9020b33f582db9ae54f640e152cf.png[/img]

It's been found that community can enhance one's practice by promoting focus and motivation. 🧘‍♀️🧘🏾🧘‍♂️🧘🏿🧘🏼‍♂️.

notes.title: Making Peace with Rain Update - Lessons 5 & 6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41392577/fd1ecbc818f0d11a370ed793891d928007e0db40.png[/img]

The Making Peace With Rain Lesson Pack includes 2 new lessons: Lesson 5 - Inevitability, Reactivity, and Impermanence and Lesson 6 - Off the Cushion. For PRACTICE mode, this update includes 6 new session modules and a new rain setting for the environment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41392577/1885a3728b5d8e45e9b70cd9cda000629f2c950b.png[/img]

To begin the Making Peace With Rain Lesson Pack and continue your journey through the ZenVR curriculum, simply complete Lesson 4. If you have not completed Lesson 4 yet, that is ok! We encourage completing each lesson at your own pace. Please take your time between lessons to reflect on talks, work on techniques, and practice building a regular habit of meditating. 

As a reminder, with each new Lesson completed, you can revisit the teachings in PRACTICE mode. Included in this update are 6 new unlockable modules: 2 Techniques, 2 Meditations, and 2 Talks. In addition, our first PRACTICE setting option for the environment (Rain) is also included, providing not just a visual change to the surrounding scenery but calming ambient noises for your sessions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41392577/464853f1faf92f10d6df2310e76508daf78a8fe2.png[/img]
